entities.summary: Noh bin Omar is a Malaysian politician and lawyer who served as the Minister of Entrepreneur Development and Cooperative for second term in the Barisan Nasional (BN) administration under former Prime Minister Ismail Sabri Yaakob from September 2021 to the collapse of the BN administration in November 2022 and the first term in the BN administration under former Prime Minister Abdullah Ahmad Badawi from March 2008 to April 2009, Minister of Urban Wellbeing, Housing and Local Government from June 2016 to the collapse of the BN administration in May 2018, Chairman of the Perbadanan Usahawan Nasional Berhad (PUNB) from June 2020 to September 2021.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Noh Omar's tenure as Minister of Entrepreneur Development and Cooperative had a significant impact on Malaysia's economic development, particularly in the areas of entrepreneurship and cooperative development. His leadership helped shape the country's business landscape during a period of rapid growth.
